source.source_locator: 消防法 第13条の3第3項

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 各種類の危険物取扱者試験は毎年1回以上、都道府県知事が行う。
evidence.tested_misconception: 乙種試験は需要がなければ数年間実施しなくてもよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: exam type -> annual minimum frequency -> compare two-year gap -> noncompliant

collision.note: Batch 2 application boundary; distinct from C016 taxonomy.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-3(3) directly supports at least one examination of each type every year; the two-year non-execution scenario tests application.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations. C016 adds insufficient incremental practice value and must not proceed merely to preserve the planned count.
